newsitem.title: USA: Ametek names group president, reorganizes.
newsitem.headline: Ametek names group president, reorganizes.

text.p: Ametek Inc said Monday it has named Robert Chlebek president of its instruments group, effective March 1. He joins AMETEK from Philips Components North America, a subsidiary of Philips Electronics NV, where he was president since 1993.

The company also said that following the completion of the previously announced merger of Ametek's water filtration business with Culligan Water Technologies Inc, expected to close in four to six months, it will shift to two, from three operating groups.

The precision instruments group will become the electronic instruments group, said the company, reflecting the fact that future direction of its instrument businesses is based on electronic technology.
Ametek added that its specialty metal products division will join the electromechanical group and its chemical products division will join the instruments group when the merger is completed.
The company said that with this new structure it will continue to concentrate principally on electromechanical and electronics-related businesses.
